interestingChoices: Battery competes with protection and support for sockets and weight, so energy is a real construction constraint.
Heavy automata must choose between armor, a second weapon and support rather than carrying every answer.
Repair only targets other allies, making formation and protector positioning matter.
Spider-only narrow passages, minimum ranged distance and side-swapped test-range comparisons create distinct counters.
Target priority and overload can reverse the finale without hidden stat bonuses.

limitations: Ranged attacks use grid distance, not line-of-sight raycasts.
Browser verification covers desktop and a narrow mobile viewport, not a physical-device/GPU matrix.
The full six-fight campaign was verified in deterministic simulation and the first combat was played publicly; the complete finale was not replayed in the public reader.
The legacy check-local static-web-v1 command does not support this multi-file GLB game; export validation uses the hosted browser validator instead.
